name: Floodman Operations AIO Source Handoff v4.6.7
author: admin@floodman.com
description: Floodman Operations source-handoff egg. Uses the Floodman AIO base image with the cumulative v4.6.7 launcher and runtime overlay. Includes private desktop/mobile workspaces, Full ERP guard, RoomFlow workspaces, mobile API, estimates, invoices, payments, scheduling, documents, PWA, and Tailscale.

variables.name: Source Mode
variables.description: builtin is the easiest first install and uses the source baked into the runtime image. Change to auto later to apply an uploaded floodman-source.zip when present.

variables.name: Source ZIP Filename
variables.description: Filename uploaded to the root of the Pterodactyl server. Do not extract it.

variables.name: Optional Source Download URL
variables.description: Optional HTTPS URL for panel-only automatic download. Leave blank when uploading floodman-source.zip from the Files tab.

variables.name: Optional Source SHA-256
variables.description: Optional archive checksum. Leave blank when using the internal signed manifest or upload a companion floodman-source.zip.sha256 file.

variables.name: Force Source Reapply
variables.description: Set true for one restart to reapply the same uploaded ZIP, then return it to false.

variables.name: Company Name
variables.description: Floodman organization name shown in Floodman Operations and the unified Hub.

variables.name: Owner First Name
variables.description: First name for the primary Floodman Operations Super Administrator and Floodman Owner.

variables.name: Owner Last Name
variables.description: Last name for the primary Floodman Operations Super Administrator and Floodman Owner.

variables.name: Owner Email
variables.description: Real email used to create the primary Owner. Use the same email later in RoomFlow.

variables.name: Owner Password
variables.description: Initial Owner password. 12-64 characters; letters, numbers and ! @ % _ + - are accepted. Treat this as a secret.

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: IANA time zone used by Floodman Operations, receivables and schedules.

variables.name: Public Host
variables.description: Public IP or DNS hostname used to build browser links. Leave blank to use the primary allocation IP. Do not include http:// or a port.

variables.name: Public Scheme
variables.description: Use http for direct allocation testing. Use https only when a reverse proxy terminates TLS.

variables.name: Enforce 9000 Port Scheme
variables.description: When true, startup requires primary allocation 9000 and additional allocations 9001-9004. Set false only when the panel cannot provide this block.

variables.name: Explicit Main Hub URL
variables.description: Optional complete public Hub URL. Leave blank to derive it from Public Host and the primary allocation.

variables.name: Documenso Port
variables.description: Assign TCP allocation 9001 to this server. This is the Documenso signing interface.

variables.name: Explicit Documenso URL
variables.description: Optional complete URL when using a reverse proxy or separate hostname.

variables.name: Mailpit Port
variables.description: Assign TCP allocation 9002. Mailpit is a test inbox and must not be exposed to untrusted users.

variables.name: Explicit Mailpit URL
variables.description: Optional complete URL when using a reverse proxy.

variables.name: Engineering Sandbox Port
variables.description: Assign TCP allocation 9003 for Square, signing, SMS, and workflow simulation.

variables.name: Explicit Engineering URL
variables.description: Optional complete URL when using a reverse proxy.

variables.name: Floodman API Port
variables.description: Assign TCP allocation 9004 for RoomFlow, provider webhooks, and Floodman API documentation.

variables.name: Explicit Floodman API URL
variables.description: Optional complete URL when using a reverse proxy.

variables.name: RoomFlow URL
variables.description: Public RoomFlow web application linked from the Hub.

variables.name: Floodman Core Node Heap MB
variables.description: Node.js memory limit for the internal Floodman Operations ERP service.

variables.name: Competitor AI Provider
variables.description: deterministic requires no external key. openai requires OPENAI_API_KEY below.

variables.name: Messaging AI Provider
variables.description: deterministic is the safe default for customer-message testing.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Optional server-side key used only when an AI provider is set to openai. Pterodactyl variables are not a hardware-backed secret vault.
